 Patchy morning fog, isolated showers possible 
 By Andrew Gorton Published : Nov. 5, 2026 at 4:41 AM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google SAVANNAH, Ga. (WTOC) - Happy Thursday! 
 We are already seeing a few isolated showers drift north this morning, although most of us will remain dry. 
 Visibility is good for most of us early this morning, but patchy fog will develop through the morning commute. Temperatures are once again starting out in the 60s, well above average for this time of the year. 
 We’ll keep the warm trend going with temperatures warming to the lower 80 by lunchtime with highs in the lower 80s. A few showers will be possible along the sea breeze late this afternoon into the early evening. Quiet conditions will remain present overnight into the morning. 
 It'll remain muggy today and tomorrow, but drier air moves in this weekend into next week! pic.twitter.com/ldQjzkk6a9 
— Andrew Gorton (@AndrewGortonWx) November 5, 2026 
 Beach and boating conditions will be decent today. Wave heights will be 2 to 3 feet at the coast with an increased risk for rip currents. The wind will be from the south at 5 to 10 miles per hour.
 Above average temperatures will remain present as we close out the week with morning lows in the mid 60s and highs in the lower 80s on Friday. Our next cold front will push through during the day, increasing the chance for scattered showers and an isolated storm or two during the afternoon. The severe threat remains low with the best chance of rain occurring over our inland communities. Highs will still be near 80 degrees with temperatures in the lower 70s at sunset. 
 Slightly cooler and drier air will filter in this weekend, with morning lows back in the upper 50s on Saturday with highs in the mid to upper 70s. More of the same is expected on Sunday with lows closer to 50 degrees followed by highs in the mid 70s. We should remain dry this weekend. Cooler air returns next week with morning lows in the 40s on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
